Friday, December 11th // Doors Open at 6:30pm, Dinner Starts at 8pm

FOE 2223 North Canton Eagles
6979 Sunset Strip Ave. NW
North Canton, Ohio 44720
MAP IT

​

Get ready for an exciting night of fun, prizes, and giving back! We’re hosting a Reverse Raffle where you could walk away with up to $2,000!

And that’s not all! Dreaming of a tropical getaway? We’ll also be auctioning off an incredible trip to Belize during our live auction! The excitement doesn’t stop there! Enjoy Bingo, Lucky 7, a 50/50 raffle, and Side Boards for even more chances to win throughout the night.

Join us on December 11, 2026, at FOE 2223 North Canton Eagles, located at 6979 Sunset Strip Ave. NW, North Canton, Ohio 44720, for an adults-only evening packed with entertainment, excitement, and incredible prizes!

Tickets are going fast, so don’t miss your chance to win big while making a difference! Every ticket helps support One of A Kind Pet Rescue and our mission to save cats and dogs in imminent danger.

Big prizes, tropical dreams, and lives saved! What better way to ring in the New Year?

Email events@example.org for tickets!

EVENT DETAILS

[/et_pb_text][et_pb_text]

Looking for a unique way to show your appreciation to your employees and create an unforgettable experience for your team? Break the routine of daily operations and bring some joy and relaxation to your work environment with One of A Kind Pet Rescue’s Corporate Puppy Parties, tailored to your location, size, and needs!

[/et_pb_text][et_pb_text]

Our Corporate Puppy Party packages are designed to provide a fun and educational experience for your team while supporting the important work of our animal rescue organization. Choose from one of three exciting packages to fit your budget and preferences:

  • “Puppy Palooza” ($5,000)
    A half-day puppy party at your location, featuring multiple puppies for interactive play, education, and bonding. Our trained puppy handlers will be on hand to supervise and ensure the safety and well-being of the puppies. Enjoy playing, cuddling, and photo-bombing, along with literature and Q&A. Designed for a larger audience, employees can pop in and out at their leisure. Our staff may also take walkabouts throughout your facility to visit with staff members as they work.
  • “Puppy Pampering” ($3,000)
    A three-hour puppy play session at your location, providing a stress-free and enjoyable experience for your team. Our puppies will be available for playtime, snuggles, and photo opportunities. Perfect for a medium-sized audience.
  • “Petite Puppy Play” ($1,000)
    A one-hour puppy cuddle and snuggle session at your nearby location, ideal for a quick break or team-building activity. Our puppies will be available for snuggles, petting, and playtime.

[/et_pb_text][et_pb_text]

All of our Corporate Puppy Party packages include:

  • A dedicated event coordinator to ensure a smooth and enjoyable experience
  • Educational materials about our animal rescue organization and the importance of adopting pets
  • Opportunities for team building and bonding through interactive play with our puppies
  • A donation to our organization to support our animal rescue efforts

[/et_pb_text][et_pb_text]

To ensure the safety and well-being of our puppies, we ask all participating locations to be environmentally safe and stress-free for the animals. We also require a minimum of 2 weeks’ notice to schedule your event.

To schedule or discuss our Corporate Puppy Party packages further, please email events@example.org. We look forward to bringing joy and relaxation to your team!

Note: A 50% deposit is required to secure the booking, with the balance due 1 week prior to the event.

Are you ready to bring some puppy love to your workplace?
